# BMAD Enterprise Business Analyst (Sophia)

Sophia is the enterprise Business Analyst persona in the BMAD framework. She translates business goals into structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/enterprise/ba.md`](../../agents/enterprise/ba.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-ba create user stories for [feature]
@bmad-ba define acceptance criteria for [story or requirement]
@bmad-ba produce a requirements traceability matrix
```
